regions.merged_text: Glad to hear from you again, not withstanding the long silence on my part. I have been here in Detroit doctoring for the last three weeks not that I have been sick actually, I guess I was run down. I had an operation on a grout /growth/ under my left eye. The doctors say that is healing up nicely. I started to write to you a number of times, and I had just about finished it, but I cannot put in this letter, because it is about 200 miles from here, at St. Felix, in Huntington. I had written the letter just before Oune's death. May his soul rest in peace. I surely sympathize with you and yours, and all our dear one and friends, not withstanding the congraulations I offer all his friends for the admir able disposition. Thanks be to God for the grace granted to him and accompanied him in his long heroic struggle for life eternal. Another beautiful death in the family, for which father and mother prayed for faithfully per- severingly; that all their children would be granted the grace of a happy death. I am sure glad, that poor brother Pat, with the grace of God is keeping up. I pray and think of him every day. He is next to me in age. He must be 83 now.
